lines: The candidate should be a citizen of India.
Students pursuing Science/Technology which are relevant to DOS/ISRO programmes only will be considered.

The number of students selected for internship may vary due to facility constraints. Applying for internship does not entitle the student to carry out internship at LPSC. It is the discretion of LPSC to accept/reject the application after the screening procedure.

Considering the increased demand for internships, it may not be possible to accommodate all the applicants. Therefore, the students are advised to identify other alternative organisations, in case of rejection of their applications.
A student will be allowed to pursue one internship per degree.

Internship is offered to students pursuing & enrolled for regular on-campus BE/B.Tech, ME/M.Tech, BSc/MSc (Chemistry) in a recognized university/institution (India/Abroad). Students pursuing BSc/MSc (Chemistry) can apply for internships only at LPSC, Bengaluru.
No stipend/remuneration/financial assistance will be given by LPSC/ISRO during the period of internship.
The duration of the internship will be minimum of 21 days and maximum of 45 days.

Eligibility for applying to Internships is as follows:
Aggregate marks /CGPA on a scale of 10
Students shall possess aggregate of Min 60% or CGPA 6.32 on a scale of 10.

The application form and declaration by student and Principal/HOD should be filled in all respects and the application form must be manadtorily attached in the Google Form. Incomplete applications will be rejected.
